attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's second finding, and the reason the first one bites. XOR exists before the externalization and exists after it, so `capability extends` is satisfied by equality and asserts nothing. What changes is that the capability gains a second realization path: model-resident inference before, model-resident inference PLUS an admitted world artifact after. Added as the eighth quantity, making the matrix 6 × 8 = 48 cells. THE CONNECTION GPT-5.6 DREW AND THIS RECORD KEEPS: this is why the proposed Substrate & Metrology Register keeps resurfacing, and why the support object is a HYPERGRAPH rather than a genealogical DAG — EMB-SUPPORT-GRAPH's kernels and cuts are set systems over exactly this quantity, which a lineage DAG cannot carry.

attrs.review_focus: Declared, not measured. The quantity has a column and an effect that requires it to strictly extend; nothing observes it, because no operation has been performed.
attrs.statement: Externalization does not change the capability set; it changes the support topology. `support_realization` — the set of realizations through which a capability can be executed — is a distinct conserved quantity from `capability`.
